scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly && pnpm run bundle
scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/index.js --external:@cotal-ai/core && esbuild src/standalone.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/standalone.js --external:@earendil-works/pi-coding-agent --external:@earendil-works/pi-tui --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cotalCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __cotalCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.test: pnpm run build && tsx pi.smoke.ts && tsx pi-sdk.smoke.ts && node --input-type=module -e "await import('./dist/standalone.js'); console.log('pi standalone smoke: import passed')"
